name: Taking Care Of Your Children
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage and reward from the Lord, emphasizing the sacred responsibility parents have in their care and upbringing. The call to 'train up a child in the way he should go' highlights the importance of guiding children according to God’s truth so they remain steadfast in faith throughout life. This care is rooted in the covenantal unity of family, as seen in the joining of husband and wife, which forms the foundation for nurturing children under God's protection and blessing.
